subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should eligible GitHub Copilot Responses models automatically use provider-hosted search when web search is enabled and no managed provider is pinned?
rationale: This intentionally changes external search routing and data flow for existing unpinned Copilot configurations; code correctness cannot establish whether that product default is desired.

options.title: Accept automatic hosted search
options.body: Use Copilot hosted search for proven eligible models while preserving managed-provider pins, disablement, and tool-policy denies.

options.title: Require explicit selection
options.body: Keep existing managed-search routing unless an approved explicit selection enables Copilot hosted search.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic hosted search
recommendation.body: Use Copilot hosted search for proven eligible models while preserving managed-provider pins, disablement, and tool-policy denies.
